newsitem.title: FINLAND: INDUSTRY, CONSTRUCTION LEAD FINNISH NOV GDP GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRY, CONSTRUCTION LEAD FINNISH NOV GDP GROWTH.

text.p: Industry, with over seven percent seasonally adjusted growth, and construction, up six percent, took Finnish November GDP four percent higher year-on-year, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Thursday.
"Production increased in all sectors except agriculture and forestry," SF said in a statement.
Production increased more than two percent in the trade sector, five percent in transports and communication and two percent in other services and the public sector, it said.
Agriculture and forestry output fell 6.5 percent year-on-year in November.
